memory_candidates.content: Modular intuitionistic modal extensions (IT/IS4/IS5) over an existing IK birelational canonical model are best structured as one small shared scaffold Extension.lean (a frame-condition-parametrized validity IValidFC = IValid + one binder FC r, plus ivalidFC_completeness = ivalid_completeness + hypothesis FC canonicalR threaded into the h_valid application, ~2-line diff, plus an axiom_mem helper) followed by three thin nested-import files IT<-IS4<-IS5, mirroring classical Systems/{T,S4,S5}. Each extension's only genuinely new proofs are the per-axiom soundness cases and one positive canonical-closure lemma per frame condition (Reflexive/Transitive/Symmetric via canonical_imp_property MP-closure). This keeps task-480/492 assets zero-churn. A generic frame-condition typeclass is NOT worth it - it obscures the concrete instantiations reviewers expect.

IValidFC's frame-condition parameter FC must be typed as {World : Type v} -> (World -> World -> Prop) -> Prop (implicit World) so that Mathlib's Reflexive/Transitive/Symmetric (already polymorphic over an implicit carrier) can be passed directly as FC instantiations without any adapter or new predicate definitions.
